40000433:127685.name: Cart Cards
40000433:127685.description: Cart line item. Type=One-time: simple add-on. One-time package: a package with included parts and optional extras. One-time overlap: price already reduced by shared extras. Member price: standard price crossed out above the member price. Member price package: member price with the base check paid by an available credit. Membership: the recurring item, always in the Billed yearly group. Included: paid fully with an available credit.

40000318:82143.name: Member view switch card
40000318:82143.description: Iteration 1. Sits above the package grid on every tab. Switching on previews member prices across the page; membership is added to the cart only when a visit is booked. Logged-in members see State=On with the switch locked.

40000480:40167.name: Cart Card Detail
40000480:40167.description: Rows inside a Cart Card. Included: part of the package. Included in membership: paid with an available credit. Removable / Removed: optional extra such as a radon reading; removing it never changes the price. Overlap discount: extras already in another item are subtracted from this item’s price.

40000480:40178.name: Cart Group Header
40000480:40178.description: Labels each group of cart items so recurring and one-time charges are never mixed. Recurring group always sits first.

40000480:40210.name: Cart Appointment
40000480:40210.description: Shows the chosen area and slot once they are picked in the funnel. Not scheduled: shown when the cart is opened before location and time are chosen. Change returns to the location step.

40000480:40225.name: Cart Summary Row
40000480:40225.description: Totals block rows. Saving rows (member savings, overlap, discount code) are green and negative. Recurring row shows the yearly fee separately from one-time items. Total is always “Due today”. Note explains when the recurring fee is charged next.

40000498:91300.name: Cart Membership Switch
40000498:91300.description: Top of the cart body for anyone not logged in with an active membership. Choosing an option switches the whole cart between one-off and member prices: On adds the membership (and the included base check when the cart has no core check); Off removes them. Both totals stay visible so the saving is obvious. “Already a member? Log in” opens the shared login layer. Hidden for logged-in members.

40000498:91344.name: Cart Notice
40000498:91344.description: Blocked: replaces the summary in the sticky footer when checkout is not possible; Continue is disabled and the notice offers one-tap fixes. Info: inline “change receipt” placed where the cart changed by itself (for example a duplicate check removed); stays until dismissed or the sheet closes. Undo toast: after the customer removes an item; floats above the footer for 6 seconds.

40000498:91376.name: Cart Bar (mobile)
40000498:91376.description: Mobile only. Sticky at the bottom of the package selector once something is in the cart. Tapping anywhere opens the Cart bottom sheet. Updates live as items change.
